user.title: What to add
user.description: A supply computes the cost of one contract. The GME account downloads the PUN for every supply, with your own GME credentials.

contract.title: Supply contract
contract.description:
Paste the contract as JSON. It holds only what your supplier decides: prices, fees, how dispatching is billed. The README explains the format and how to get it from a bill.

{details}

supply.title: Supply and meters
supply.description: These do not depend on the supplier. You find them on any bill.

data_description.resident: Decides the excise allowance and the fixed system charge.
data_description.power_kw: The contracted power (potenza impegnata), in kW.
data_description.meters: One or more cumulative energy sensors that measure what you draw from the grid. Their increases are added together.

market.title: Market values
market.description: Your contract is priced with the values below, which change every month. For each one choose an entity or type a fixed number in €/kWh, not both. An entity may report €/kWh or €/MWh. The sensors of the GME account, if you added it, are already filled in.

gme_account.title: GME account
gme_account.description: The PUN is downloaded from the official GME API with your own credentials, which GME gives each user who registers at {url}. Data source: Gestore dei Mercati Energetici S.p.A.

reauth_confirm.title: GME account
reauth_confirm.description: GME refused the saved credentials. Enter them again; if you lost them, ask GME (registration at {url}).

error.invalid_contract: The contract is not valid. The problems are listed above.
error.entity_or_value: Fill in either the entity or the fixed value, not both.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the GME API. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: The GME account is already configured.
